Order on Criminal Misc. Correction Application No. 3 of 2023
1.
Heard Sri Manish Kumar Pandey, Advocate, holding brief of Sri R.K. Paramhans Singh, learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners, by drawing attention to the certified copy of the first information report, submits that by typographical mistake, incorrect sections have been mentioned in the prayer clause, which in the interest of justice are liable to be corrected.

3. We find that the prayer made in the stay application mentions the correct sections and even the arguments were advanced on the basis of correct sections as noted in paragraph no. 5 of the writ Vishal Singh And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172571312/
1 petition.

sentences.text: Therefore, he submits that he may be permitted to correct the prayer clause.
He may do so during the course of the day.

5. Paragraph nos. 4 and 10 of the order dated 16.05.2023 are substituted as follows :-
"4.

The present writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to quash the impugned first information report dated 27.03.2023 registered as Case Crime No.
197 of 2023 under Sections 376, 313, 504, 506 I.P.C. & 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act,
Police Station- Hata, District- Kushi Nagar, and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioners in pursuance of the impugned first information report.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
10. Till the next date of listing or till submission of police report under Section 173 (2)
Cr.P.C., whichever is earlier, the petitioners herein shall not be arrested in pursuance of the impugned first information report dated 27.03.2023 registered as Case Crime No. 197 of 2023 under Sections 376, 313, 504, 506 I.P.C. & 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Hata, District- Kushi Nagar, provided the petitioner cooperates in the investigation."
